title: Follow the native forest practice code and notify before harvesting
what: Conduct a native forest practice (selective timber harvesting in native forest) only in line with the accepted development vegetation clearing code, including notifying the chief executive beforehand; otherwise a development approval is needed.

sources.title: Vegetation Management Act 1999 (Qld)
sources.quote: For the Planning Act , the activity is accepted development only if and to the extent the activity complies with the code

sources.title: Vegetation Management Act 1999 (Qld)
